why_not: I buy my makeup from brands I know, at Ulta or the counter where I can try it on. A $36 balm from a website I've never heard of, with no reviews, from a Facebook ad? I'd scroll right past it.

Thirty-six dollars for a tinted balm from a brand I've never heard of, with not a single review, from an Instagram ad? I've bought these color-changing balms before and they all ended up drying my lips by lunchtime, so I'll pass. I can afford it, I just don't pay full price for a gamble.

$36 is a lot for a tinted balm from a brand I've never heard of with zero reviews, when I can get a color-changing balm at Ulta for a fraction of that with a coupon. The guarantee is nice, but I'd still have to find out the hard way whether it burns my lips and then chase a refund.

$36 for a tinted lip balm is more than I'll pay when I can get something similar for $10 to $20 at the drugstore. Even the two-for-$59 deal still works out to almost $30 each, and that's no bargain to me.
